one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: A Bengaluru-based precision engineering company making machined components, sheet metal parts and integrated assemblies for mission-critical railways, aerospace, defence and semiconductor applications.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Millworks manufactures precision-engineered components and sub-assemblies used in regulated, mission-critical applications across aerospace, defence, railways and semiconductor machinery. It operates under Build-to-Print (BTP) and Build-to-Spec (BTS) engagement models, plus job-work arrangements, and primarily supplies Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs). In fiscal 2026 revenue from operations was Rs 14,876.70 lakhs, of which 27.47% was exports to customers in 9 countries.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- V3 Technologies — Partnership firm - other venture of Promoters (Mr. Sridhar Acharya and Mrs. Rashmi Sridhar Acharya)
- Grynn Advanced Private Limited — Indian company - other venture of Promoter Mrs. Rashmi Sridhar Acharya; also other directorship listed for her
- Alined Technologies — Partnership firm - other venture of Promoter Mrs. Rashmi Sridhar Acharya
- None — Group Companies: Board identified that there are no Group Companies

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Aerospace:** turbocharger components, fuel filter components / precision screens, turbine blades, nozzle components
- **Defence:** missile airframe components, guidance system housings, structural brackets and mounts, hydraulic cylinder parts, levelling and alignment components, drone structural frames, drone motor housings, BLDC motor stators, BLDC motor rotors, anti-drone system housings/brackets/support structures, drone sub-assembly assembly
- **Railways:** braking system components (air brake), train and metro door system components and actuators, train coupler components, pantograph system components
- **Semiconductor:** machine base frames, precision brackets and mounts, alignment plates, equipment housings, chip handling fixtures, load testing fixtures

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Defence (69.43% FY26)
- Railways (23.65% FY26)
- Semiconductor (5.94% FY26)
- Aerospace (0.99% FY26)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: The Company primarily supplies OEMs, Tier-1 and Tier-2 suppliers under Build-to-Print (BTP) and Build-to-Spec (BTS) engagement models, including full-scope manufacturing and job-work. Manufacturing is largely in-house across four Bengaluru units covering precision machining, sheet metal fabrication, sub-assembly and inspection. Surface treatment and finishing processes such as anodizing, passivation, electroless nickel plating and chemical blackening are outsourced to qualified external vendors under Company supervision, with material test certificates and process qualification records maintained. Forward participation in the drone ecosystem is pursued via a strategic investment of Rs. 5.75 crore in Quick Pay Private Limited (existing unsecured loan converted to equity), under which the Company manufactures and supplies drone components while Quick Pay handles integration, marketing and sale of finished drones. Big Bang Boom Solutions Private Limited is identified as a strategic supplier providing facility access, sub-assembly coordination and integration assistance for time-sensitive defence programs, including partial drone assembly at the partner's facility and 'Bill-to Ship-to' dispatch to customers.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Sharp revenue growth driven by the Defence sector, which surged to 69.43% of FY26 revenue (Rs 10,325.82 lakhs)
- Revenue volatility - operations grew from Rs 938.60 lakhs (FY24) to Rs 2,210.01 lakhs (FY25) to Rs 14,876.70 lakhs (FY26)
- High customer concentration - top five customers contributed 81.07% and top ten 92.06% of FY26 revenue
- Growth in repeat customers and rising average order value (AOV grew to Rs 48.04 lakhs in FY25)
- Export mix of 27.47% of FY26 revenue exposes results to forex and international demand
- Margin expansion - EBITDA margin rose from 29.55% (FY24) to 36.71% (FY26)

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Serve diverse customer programs across regulated sectors within a common manufacturing and quality framework using the dual BTP/BTS model
- Focus on low- to medium-volume production for mission-critical, customised, technically complex components
- Expand manufacturing capacity by investing in plant and machinery from IPO proceeds
- Grow export operations in aerospace and semiconductor machinery segments (27.47% of FY26 revenue from 9 countries)

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The Company intends to fund capital expenditure to purchase additional Plant and Machinery (up to Rs 6,103.25 lakhs from IPO proceeds) to augment its four Bengaluru manufacturing units, alongside funding working capital requirements. Installed capacity was 1,63,952 hours in FY24 (91,450 hours utilized) and increased by 57,358 hours in FY25.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Precision engineering capability and manufacturing of complex, low-to-medium-volume components across diverse materials (Aluminium, Titanium, Stainless Steel, Brass, Polycarbonates)
- Certified quality management systems (AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015, multi-site) supporting process discipline and documentation control
- Comprehensive manufacturing infrastructure across four units in Bengaluru covering precision machining, sheet metal fabrication and assembly
- Diversified presence across four regulated, mission-critical sectors (aerospace, defence, railways, semiconductor)
- Experienced management team led by Promoters with engineering and operations backgrounds

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Significant revenue fluctuations — Revenue swung from Rs 938.60 lakhs (FY24) to Rs 2,210.01 lakhs (FY25) to Rs 14,876.70 lakhs (FY26); variations may not indicate a consistent growth trend
- Customer concentration — Top five customers contributed 81.07% and top ten 92.06% of FY26 revenue from operations; loss of a key customer could materially hurt results
- Sector concentration in Defence — Defence alone accounted for 69.43% of FY26 revenue, making performance dependent on continued defence demand and approvals
- Export and foreign-exchange exposure — 27.47% of FY26 revenue derived from exports to 9 countries, exposing the Company to forex and international demand risk
- Short operating history — Company was incorporated only in 2021, giving limited track record for assessing performance
- Dependence on OEM customers and BTP/BTS approvals — Primarily supplies OEMs under build-to-print/build-to-spec models requiring customer approvals; loss of qualifications could disrupt orders

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Fund capital expenditure to purchase Plant and Machinery from IPO net proceeds to expand manufacturing capacity.**
- **Fund the Company's working capital requirements, with Rs 8,150.00 lakhs of the Rs 16,427.00 lakhs requirement met from IPO proceeds.**
- **Complete a fresh issue of up to 48,44,000 equity shares of face value Rs 10 each on the BSE SME platform to fund objects of the issue.**
- **Augment installed manufacturing capacity across the four Bengaluru units through investment in additional plant and machinery.**
- **Grow export operations catering to aerospace and semiconductor machinery customers (27.47% of FY26 revenue from 9 countries).**
